_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 32, TWSC Example Problem 3: four-leg TWSC intersection with two-stage gap acceptance (median storage n_m = 2) and flared minor approaches (n_R = 1). Demand values are the published flow rates (hourly volumes already divided by PHF = 0.92), veh/h. The conflicting-flow overrides reproduce the published Stage I/II conflicting flows, which follow the HCM 6th Edition equation forms rather than the 7th Edition Exhibit 20-14/20-16 factors (see VERIFY-HCM note in src/hcm/chapter20/twsc.rs).
